overview: The United States is a large country with many climates, famous cities, national parks, and several time zones.
climate: The climate ranges from arctic in Alaska to tropical in Hawaii and Florida.
bestSeason: Spring and autumn are often comfortable in many cities.
travelTips: Distances are big, so domestic flights are common between faraway cities.
